concept: EC2 rightsizing: Compute Optimizer and Cost Explorer
tests: Which tools identify idle/underutilized EC2 instances and give sizing recommendations.
expected: AWS Compute Optimizer (utilization analysis, instance type recommendations) + Cost Explorer rightsizing recommendations. Triggers: "idle and underutilized", "right-sizing recommendations".
why_not: Inspector — vulnerabilities; WAF — web traffic; Macie — sensitive data.
